Business me grahak kaise badhaye

Grahak aapki dukaan ke saamne se guzarta hai. Kya use pata chalta hai ki aap bechte kya hain?

1. Kaam bada likhiye, naam chhota. Dawai, kapde, mobile repair.
2. Akshar doori ke hisaab se: har 10 foot pe lagbhag 1 inch. Sadak ke us paar 30 foot? Kam se kam 3 inch.
3. Halke pe gehra, gehre pe halka. Shaam ko board pe light.
4. Board ke neeche asli maal rakhiye, door se dikhe.

Save kar lijiye. Sadak ke us paar se aapka board padha jaata hai? 👇
